title: Archery Target Plant Figure
description: A tall humanoid figure composed entirely of green mullein plants stands in a cracked desert landscape. Its head and torso feature concentric red and white archery targets, with lit candles and yellow flowers growing from the stalks, while arrows pierce its body and dark multicolored smoke swirls around its base.
prompt: A surreal tall humanoid figure made of green mullein stalks and leaves stands in a barren cracked desert at sunset. Its head and chest display bold red and white concentric archery targets with red liquid dripping down. Lit candles and yellow flowers grow from the plant body. Multiple arrows pierce through the figure. Dark swirling smoke in neon green, purple and black rises from the ground. Dramatic stormy sky with a large red sun, shattered iridescent glass effect across the scene, dark clouds and fiery light in the distance.
